source_description: CWC river water level telemetry (hourly), file rwl_tel_hr_cwc_009_2021_2025.csv, station UPPER ANICUT; converted by src.cwc_adapter

timestamp_interpretation.note: The export does not state its timezone. Offset applied by assumption; verify with the data provider.

level_interpretation.note: Values are copied as reported in metres. The file does not state the datum; compare with RL_of_zeroGauge before interpreting them as gauge height or reduced level.

notes: Raw telemetry: values are not quality-controlled by this converter.
The download origin of the file is not verified by the software.
